name: Gonzalo C. Martinez
office: Presiding Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Seven

items.text: Gonzalo C. Martinez has served on the Second District Court of Appeal, Division Seven, since 2023 and became presiding justice in 2024. He was a deputy judicial appointments secretary in the governor's office, a Squire Patton Boggs partner, and a Harvard Law School graduate. In 2026, he ruled Los Angeles may bar evictions for tenants owing less than a month's rent. The California Supreme Court is reviewing the decision.
